text: {"lessons":["A few positive months did not prevent a sharp decline later; I should plan for losses and avoid assuming recent gains will continue.","Doing nothing during the downturn avoided reactive trades, but I should still review whether my holdings and risk fit my apartment goal rather than let the portfolio drift.","Before trading, I should check how a proposed buy or sale changes my overall exposure and keep decisions consistent with a long-term plan, not short-term price swings."]}
